title: ntfy
description: Publishes the event as a push notification through ntfy.sh or a self-hosted ntfy server.

token.title: Access token
token.description: ntfy access token, sent as a Bearer Authorization header. Leave empty for a public topic.

caPem.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caPem.description: Additional trusted root certificate(s) for a self-hosted server, PEM-encoded.
